snapshots.note: Draft 1: criteria classifier with 4 conditions (dehumanizing, violence, sexualized_abuse, group_hostility). Predicts 73% hate on pool. Need to calibrate with labels.

Draft 2: clarified instructions to distinguish policy positions from hate. Accuracy: 90% on 10-label check set (macro-F1: 0.89). Pool predictions: 63% hate. 1 remaining false positive: news report with #SendThemBack.

Final: Draft 4 - conservative criteria classifier. Accuracy: 60% on 30 labels (macro-F1: 0.58). Pool: 65.6% hate. Key distinctions: explicit dehumanization, violence calls, sexual abuse, hostility vs. policy/criticism.
